answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 3832 Country: United States of America Title: What is the best way for a woman to get benfit from one's shaykh. Can she talk to him and if so what is the best way according to sunnah and shariah. Question: Assalamualikum wa rahamtullahi wa baraktuhu, 1)What is the best way for a woman to get benfit from one's shaykh. Can she talk to him and if so what is the best way according to sunnah and shariah. Jazakallahukhiar Answer ID: 3832 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 389/367=L) The best way for a woman to get benefit from her sheikh is to write her accounts with the signature of her husband or get it written by husband and seek guidance from the sheikh. If needed she can talk to her sheikh in the presence of her husband or mahram (immediate relatives) observing hijab . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
